title: Offer to pull a recommended model into an idle local engine
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. If Ollama or LM Studio is running with no model, offer the best-fitting one for this hardware (consent, disk budget respected). Tests zc_engine_autopull_*.
